# AstroSatya

> Premium Vedic astrology platform — kundli, daily horoscope, and matchmaking, thoughtfully designed for modern seekers.

- [Home](/): Brand overview and entry into kundli, horoscope, and matchmaking.

- [Vedic Matchmaking](/matchmaking): Ashtakoot 36-guna compatibility analysis.
- [About](/about): Our story, values, and philosophy.
